# Data Source: catalyst_slate_apps

List existing Slate app identities using the official CLI's Slate API. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.Slate.app.READ` and project access. Reads IDs and names. App configuration, environment variables and build logs are omitted. Verified offline. Results are sorted lexicographically by ID. An empty project returns an empty list; denied access or malformed responses return an error.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_slate_apps" "existing" {
  project_id = "123456789"
}

output "slate_apps" {
  value = data.catalyst_slate_apps.existing.apps
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID, written as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `apps` (Attributes List) Existing infrastructure, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Numeric ID represented as a string without loss of precision.
- `name` (String) Name reported by Catalyst.
